summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Xtrackers Russell US Multifactor ETF (DEUS) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Russell 1000 Comprehensive Factor index. The fund selects and weights securities within the Russell 1000 by five different factors. DEUS was launched on Nov 24, 2015 and is issued by Xtrackers.

holdings.infoBox: DEUS is an equity ETF with a total of 866 individual holdings. The top holdings are The Allstate Corporation stock at 0.91%, Archer-Daniels-Midland Company at 0.90%, McKesson at 0.77%, Regeneron Pharmaceuticals at 0.68%, and Simon Property Group at 0.55%.
